title: Euro set for third weekly decline as hawkish Federal Reserve outlook weighs
summary: EUR/USD edges higher on Friday as the US Dollar (USD) pauses after a strong weekly rally, allowing the Euro (EUR) to recover some ground. However, the pair remains on track for a third consecutive weekly decline.

title: British Pound finds relief as USD pauses, but inflation risks linger
summary: The Pound Sterling trims some of its weekly losses, gaining over 0.18% against the US Dollar on Friday as the US Dollar takes a breather, even as US Treasury yields continue to rise.

title: EU Shrugs Off Gas Supply Fears Despite Low Storage Levels

title: Trump’s Diesel Export Threat Puts Britain on Edge
summary: President Trump’s newest trade threat sent markets into a frenzy once again on Friday. Earlier this week, Trump said he would back Republican proposals to halt exports of diesel in order to ease prices ahead of mid-term elections in November. US Treasury secretary Scott Bessent said there was a review underway of whether a ban could work as American diesel prices reached record highs at over £4.87 a gallon.
